name: LTX-Video
tagline: Real-time DiT-based local video generation model producing 24fps clips faster than playback duration on consumer GPUs.
real_test_summary: Tested quantized LTX-Video workflows locally inside ComfyUI for both text-to-video and image-to-video prompts. Generates 5-second 24fps drafts rapidly for fast visual iteration.
pros: Significantly faster generation speed than competing open-weight video diffusion models
Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video extension in ComfyUI
FP8 quantized checkpoints fit comfortably within 8GB-12GB consumer VRAM
cons: Fine details can soften during fast camera motion compared to larger models
Prompt adherence benefits from detailed descriptive scene phrasing
